serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to a Pyright `langserver` executable. Leave empty to use the copy the editor installed, or the server that ships with this package.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which parts of Pyright the editor uses. Turning one off hands it to the next server serving the same file, which is how you choose between Pyright and another Python server. Only what Pyright implements is listed: it has no formatter, inlay hints, code lens, or semantic tokens.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report Pyright's type errors and warnings in the linter.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Show Pyright's types and documentation on hover.

signature.title: Signature Help
signature.description: Show the call signature while typing arguments.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Resolve definitions and declarations through Pyright.

references.title: Find References
references.description: List occurrences of a symbol through Pyright.

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: Serve document and project symbols to go-to-symbol.

outline.title: Outline
outline.description: Fill the outline panel from Pyright's document symbols.

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Rename symbols across the project through Pyright.

codeActions.title: Code Actions
codeActions.description: Offer Pyright's quick fixes in the intentions list.

pythonPath.title: Python Path
pythonPath.description: Path to the Python interpreter used for analysis. Leave empty for automatic discovery.

venvPath.title: Virtual Environment Path
venvPath.description: Path to the folder that holds your virtual environments, not to one of them. Leave empty to let Pyright find the environment itself.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.description: What Pyright reads and how strictly it reads it. A `pyrightconfig.json` or the `[tool.pyright]` table of `pyproject.toml` overrides these for the project that has one, and is the only place to override the severity of an individual rule.

diagnosticMode.title: Diagnostic Mode
diagnosticMode.description: Analyze only the open files or the whole workspace. Checking the workspace finds errors in files you have not opened, at the cost of a much longer first analysis.

extraPaths.title: Extra Paths
extraPaths.description: Additional directories to search for imports, for source layouts Pyright cannot infer — a `src` root, a vendored library, a generated stub tree. Relative paths resolve against the project root.

stubPath.title: Stub Path
stubPath.description: Directory holding your own type stubs. Leave empty for the conventional `typings` directory.

typeshedPaths.title: Typeshed Paths
typeshedPaths.description: Where to look for typeshed's bundled stubs instead of the copy that ships with Pyright. Only the first entry is used.

include.title: Include
include.description: Paths to analyze. Leave empty to analyze the whole project root.

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Paths not to analyze at all, such as a build directory or a vendored tree.

ignore.title: Ignore
ignore.description: Paths that are still analyzed, because other files import them, but report no diagnostics of their own.

autoSearchPaths.title: Automatic Search Paths
autoSearchPaths.description: Treat the conventional roots as import paths, so a `src` directory beside the project root resolves without listing it above.

useLibraryCodeForTypes.title: Use Library Code For Types
useLibraryCodeForTypes.description: Infer types by reading a library's source when it ships no stubs. Turning this off leaves untyped libraries as `Unknown`.

autoImportCompletions.title: Auto-Import Completions
autoImportCompletions.description: Offer symbols that are not imported yet and add the import when one is accepted.

logLevel.title: Log Level
logLevel.description: How much Pyright writes to its log, which `ide-client:show-log` opens.
